title: German Potato Dumplings (Kartoffelklöße)
description: A classic German side dish made from grated potatoes and flour, boiled and served with butter or topped with a fried egg.
instructions: Boil the potatoes in a large pot of salted water until tender.
Drain the potatoes and mash in a large bowl with a fork.
Add the flour, parsley, chives, and salt to the potatoes and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5-7 minutes until smooth.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and roll each piece into a ball.
Boil the dumplings in a large pot of salted water for 10-12 minutes, or until they float to the surface.
Drain the dumplings and serve with melted butter or topped with a fried egg.
